integrity: Exact finite coefficient checks are independent of the analytic proof; no finite computation is treated as proof of the asymptotic law. The proof explicitly establishes local Fourier domination and all-moment uniform integrability.
limitations: Uniform overpartitions of fixed size only; odd-restricted search (overlined or not) only, not the ordinary mex filtered for parity; all moments are for each fixed real positive exponent; limit contains no rate estimate. Earlier differently formulated general Gibbs-partition limit results may cover the statement; priority not independent.
title: A Rayleigh limit law for the least absent odd part of an overpartition
